title: Prototype demonstration instructions
passage: Thank you for helping with tomorrow's product demonstration. Each table will have one prototype, one charging cable, and one feedback form. Connect each unit to its charger tonight and check that demonstration mode is on. Visitors may try the touch controls, but the settings menu should remain locked because some functions are still under development. If a unit freezes, use the backup unit at the reception table and record the event. We want detailed feedback rather than estimates of when the product will ship.
passageZh: 感謝各位協助明天的產品展示。每張桌子會有一台樣機、一條充電線和一份回饋表。請今晚把每台機器接上充電器，並確認展示模式已開啟。訪客可試用觸控操作，但設定選單應保持鎖定，因為部分功能仍在開發。如果機器當機，請使用接待桌上的備用機，並記錄事件。我們希望收集詳細回饋，而不是估計產品何時出貨。
